correctness.rationale: Every projector is uv^T with v^Tu=1, unique up to q-1 rescalings. Affine-line Fourier orthogonality gives exactly q per rational eigenline, with the field trace phase. Four matrix similarity families have correct centralizer sizes and their counts sum to q^4. Absolute trace-fibre counts give all singular multiplicities; p=2 split cancellation is included; the sharp positive minimum follows from monotonic cosine. An independent direct cyclotomic enumeration over q=2,3,4,5,7,9 checks every frequency, zero and multiplicity; exhaustive finite checks are supporting evidence, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: This is the full singular-value classification and optimally conditioned pseudoinverse of convolution by the canonical nontrivial projector conjugacy orbit in M2(Fq). It gives exact Fourier-nullspace dimensions and a sharp prime-characteristic transition from minimum q to 2q sin(pi/(2p)), rather than merely an isolated character sum or routine cardinality count. No broader application is asserted.
